influences.name: Rob Schnapf
influences.context: Elliott: 'I learned a lot of things from Rob and Tom. They have a feel for the event of a song. They would always be zooming in and out. [They'd be] into the details of how the compressor was set, but then they'd zoom out and see how that fit into the song.'

influences.name: The Beatles
influences.context: I got extremely interested in the technical stuff in the last year. I read all this stuff about the Beatles' sessions, even though there's no way to recreate those kind of sounds now.

influences.name: Nick Drake
influences.context: My manager bought Elliott's album, and I was like, "Oh, it kind of sounds like Nick Drake or something."

influences.name: The Left Banke
influences.context: He did six tracks of vocals. I was kinda like, "That seems excessive, but this reminds me of the Left Banke." And he goes, "You like the Left Banke?"

influences.name: The Zombies
influences.context: We'd listened to CDs all day, lots of Beatles, Zombies, and the Kinks. There was always Dylan hovering in the background.
